name: Comments Engine AI
author: Wondercode

sections.description:
Comments Engine AI revolutionizes the way you interact with your WordPress website by automatically generating insightful and engaging comments under your posts using cutting-edge artificial intelligence (powered by OpenAI).

Boost engagement, foster lively discussions, and build a thriving community on your site—whether you’re running a blog, news site, or e-commerce store.

The plugin is designed for ease of use, with powerful customization options that give you full control over the comment generation process. Set your preferred language, tone, author names, and more to create authentic interactions that feel natural and relevant to your audience.

Visit the Official Website
Watch the YouTube Tutorial

What is included ?

Free Version of Comments Engine AI

  • Generate comments for every post
  • Select OpenAI GPT Version
  • Choose the language for comments
  • Generate author names or provide a custom list of users
  • Customize your AI prompt for tailored comments
  • WooCommerce review ratings now supported!

PRO Version of Comments Engine AI

Unlock advanced features to supercharge your website’s engagement!

  • Bulk comment generation for multiple posts
  • Random author tones for diverse comment styles
  • Desired gender of nicknames
  • Add misspellings for a more realistic touch
  • Generate replies to comments for dynamic discussions
  • Fully customizable Cron settings for automation
  • Compatibility with popular tools like REST API, WPeMatico, FeedWordPress, WP All Import and WP Automatic Plugin
  • Avatar images to comments for a personalized touch
  • Configure comment length for more tailored content
  • 24-hour premium support for PRO users

Special Offer: BLACK FRIDAY

Get a 30% discount for BLACK FRIDAY until November 30 for the Pro version with the code: CEAIBLACKFRIDAY24

sections.installation:
1. Activate the plugin.
  2. Go to the menu tab “Comments Engine AI” under “Comments”.
  3. Configure your settings : openAI API Key, language & others settings
  4. Go into a post, you will get the “Add comments” metabox, set your settings and “Click to generate”
  5. Wait a few seconds and a new browser tab will open showing your new comments.
